(353)mgon po tshogs bdag gi rten sgrub mchod pa'i rten ni/bing rnams bla rdo srog 'khor/pha waṃ long bu'i steng hūm̐ dang 'og gri khrag gi bh+yo bra

tei:div.tei:p: mgon po tshogs bdag gi rten sgrub mchod pa'i rten ni/ bing rnams bla rdo srog 'khor/ pha waṃ long bu'i steng hūm̐ dang 'og gri khrag gi bh+yo bris yab yum so so'i sngags mgo phyir bstan ste rin po ches bris/ dar nag mu khyud phying bar du mtshal dkar gyis sha sa na yi sngags yig mgo nang bstan du bris/ dbus su pha waṃ long bu bzhag gri lcags khab sor bzhi la gri khrag gi mthing shog ngos hūm̐ bh+yo zung 'brel bris te dril la/ so ngar gri khrag gis blud mig tu mtshon skud sna lngas brgyud de dril cing bzhag na chos skyong thams cad dbang med par 'khor/ gri snying ma nyams pa'i nang du 'bru sman spos phye sogs sna tshogs blugs la/ bdud rtsi lnga ni/ gu gul/ tsan dan/ a ru gser mdog chu dag dkar po/ ghi waṃ/ ru rta/ spang spos/ ba ru skyu ru/ li shi rdzas bcu ste chang dang sbyar/ phyi la byugs/ nang du btang la/ snod gtsang du bzhag dri chus byugs/ stag gzig gi rgyal mtshan bcas bzhag na phyi yi rten yin/ des 'jig rten pa'i dregs pa thams cad rang dbang med par 'khor/ ༈ nang gi rten ni/ lug nag gi snying nang rtsa dbu ma'i nang du rgya shog la ma hā kā la 'i (354) rtsa sngags nang sha sa na 'i sngags bcas rin po ches bris la bcug go las mgon gsum gyi bsad sngags gri khrag gis bris la g.yon ro ma'i nang du bcug yum gyi rtsa sngags g.yu yis bris te g.yas rkyang ma'i nang du bcug 'bru sman rin chen phyes skong aṛta sa byugs la zhing chen phan dang dar snas brgyan pa'o// ye shes chos skyong thams cad rang dbang med par 'khor ro// ༈ gsang rten ni/ bsam gyi snying nang du rgya shog ngos mu khyud phying gi dbus su/ gru gsum du hūm̐ bh+yo zhes dang mdun g.yas g.yon du hūm̐ gsum mgo nang bstan pa'i phyi la rtsa sngags kyis bskor nas/ phyi rim la ā li/ yig brgya/ ye dhar sogs bris dpe'u ris ltar bcug la rin po che dang bdud rtsi lngas byug cing*/

dar sna lnga'i phan/ mi lpags kyi paṇa/ dar nag gi gdugs/ gri lag gri rkang*/ bya rta mda' dar dngul gyi me long sogs/ g.yang gi rten yin pas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma thams cad rang dbang med par 'du zhing 'khor/ ༈ bsad bing 'khor lo'i rjes ni/ zing nag dang gnam khyi zas 'tshol ra hu la sogs rgyu dus/ mtshon cha'i 'khor lo dang bsad 'khor dpe'u ris ltar bris la lcags khab sogs bing gi dbal so la bcug la/ ra khyi phag bong bu/ mgal (355) me sogs nag po rnams khrag gri khrag mngal khrag gcan gzan khrag bya sha zan khrag mdze btsog rims nad gsum/ rtsangs sbal sbrul sdom sdig gi khrag yungs dkar nag ke tshe/ shang tshe/ gu gul/ btsan dug lcags phye/ zangs phye/ sbyar dug nal khrag dbyi dug l+h+wam tshang sogs sbyar te/ bya rog 'ug sgro/ lhan cig nyin phyed yol dus su bing gi stod smad thams cad du byugs la/ bing bskyed man ngag rab gnas bya'o/ ༈ bzlog pa'i bing la yang*/ mtshon cha'i rgya mdud bar ma'i nang bcug go 'khor lo gong ltar la/ nyi nag bdud nyi shar dus bris te bing sked bcug nya chen zhes sram gyi snying khrag nya yi snying khrag rta nag lug nag khyi nag gsum gyi snying khrag zangs phye sman raka bsrais pa gong ltar bya'o/ ༈ nor lha'i bing gi rked par gser khrab dang 'khor lo dpe'u ris ltar/ bkra shis nyi ma g.yang gi gza' skar dus su/ bzang drug sna tshogs/ g.yang rdzas rin chen phye ma'i rigs rnams legs par byug cing bsgrub ste sgam du gzhug ༈ g.yang bing rdzas ni/ g.yang nyi dus/ rtse nor bu la nor lha'i rdzas byugs/ bar mtshon cha 'khor lor sman rak+ta zangs phye (356) nyi nag gnyin byug go smad dbal so'i rdzas bsad bing ltar/ gza' rā hu la dar dus byugs so/ ༈ mgon po tshogs kyi bdag po'i srog 'khor ni/ dar nag po'i ngos la/ gsham gsal dri bzang rnams bra bsres pa'i gser ram mtshal gyis rim pa bzhi bskor gyi lte ba gru gsum mdun bstan gyi dbus su

hūm̐ bh+yo zung 'brel/ zla gam gsum la hūm̐ gsum mgo nang bstan te bri/ de rgyab mu khyud la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ma hā kā la sid+dhi yaṃ dzaḥdzaḥ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la gu ṇa hrī dā hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa bai tā li hūm̐ dang*/ yang de'i gsham du hūm̐ phaṭaḥdzaḥdzaḥ zhes bri/ de rgyab 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la hūm̐ mgo phyir bstan te bri/ de rgyab mu khyud la oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ga ṇa pa ri sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces dang ye dharma spel tshig bcas/ de rgyab me ri g.yas bskor du bri/ gang la'ang bla rdo dang srung 'khor sogs spel tshig gis sgyur chog go ༈ yang bai ro tsa nas dha na saṃ kri ta la zhus pa srung 'khor skyed pa'i zil gnon du grags pa'i phan yon byin rlabs shin tu che ba ni/ gza' skar dus tshes bzang por sman shog ngos rin po che'i khu ba'am rgya snag gis mu khyud rim par bskor ba'i lte bar hūm̐ bh+yo/ de'i mtha' bskor du oṃ shrī ma hā kā la hūm̐ (357)phaṭaḥ oṃ shrī badz+ra yak+ṣa be ta li hūm̐ dzaḥ bri/ de rgyab mu khyud la/ oṃ wa gi shwa ri mum̐ḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ḥ oṃ badz+ra pa ṇi hūm̐ḥ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la wā ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐ḥ zhes spel tshig dgod/ de rgyab mu khyud la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la hūm̐ brgyad bri/ rtsibs mchan la srungs shig re re bri/ de rgyab mu khyud la rtsibs brgyad la bkra shis rdzas brgyad/ rtsibs mchan la rgyal srid sna bdun bri/ sa stong gcig der bum pa bri/ de rgyab mu khyud la/ oṃ tsakra rat+na sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ dzaḥ sngags thog mtha' des 'gres te tsakra'i mal du/ ma ṇi wa stiḥ ma hā ta ha stiḥ bhu taṃ ga la shwaḥ kharga naṃ meḥ bcug pa bri/ de rgyab mu khyud yangs pa la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la hūm̐ dzaḥ ma hā kā la sid+dhi yaṃ du dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa be ta li hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ shrī ma hā kā las dgra bo'i snying 'byinaḥ

snying la su tri dgra bo'i tsit+ta rbadaḥ oṃ ma hā kā la nṛ tham ril rbadaḥ su ṇi dzaḥ sha truṃ tsit+ta ma ra ya rbadaḥ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa be ta li hūm̐ phaṭaḥ trag rak+ṣa rag mo thuṃ lingaḥ snying la 'dus 'dusaḥ srog la sring sring shaṃ shaṃ khyer bh+yoḥ trag rak+ṣa rak+mo thuṃ ril rbadaḥ snying kha la rak+ṣa dzaḥdzaḥ(358)thuṃ ril ri li li bh+yoḥ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la gu ṇa hrī dā kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba sha truṃ bhin+dha mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la dzam+bha la dzā lan+t+ra sid+dhi 'dus 'dusaḥ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa bai tā li rat+na sid+dhi 'dus 'dusaḥ shin tu rgyas par spro na gzhung gi g.yang 'bod dbang sdud sngags tshangs ma skabs 'dir 'don srol yod 'dug kyang dkyus su 'di kas 'thus/ ma hā kā la rat+na sid+dhi 'dus 'dusaḥ ma hā kā la a yur+dz+nyān sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ dzaḥ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po tshogs kyi bdag pos bdag sgrub pa po la steng phyogs lha dang bar phyogs mi dang*/ 'og phyogs klu dang phyogs skyong ba bcu dang*/ lha srin sde brgyad thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod snyan grags mnga' thang dpal 'byor mthu stobs 'khor 'bangs sogs dngos grub thams cad bsdus nas stsol cig da lta nyid du stsol cig 'gro ba lha 'dre mi gsum gyi zas nor longs spyod 'dod rgu phun sum tshogs pa thams cad sdus shig sarba nri a kar+sha ya sha ya khug khug hrīng hring dzaḥdzaḥ ces bris/ 'dir yang rgyas par byed na/ steng lha yi tshe dang bsod nams sogs re re nas bskrol te (359) bri bar bshad do// de rgyab mu khyud la ā li kā li ye dharma bris pa'i gsham du/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa 'khor lo chen po 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas bdag sgrub pa po'i tshe dang bsod nams thams cad srungs shig spel cig srog skyobs shig 'byung ba bzhi'i dgra bgegs med par mdzod cig dgra dang chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa med par=

mi mthun pa'i phyogs ngan pa thams cad las thar bar= 'jigs pa brgyad las thar bar= tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa snyan grags 'bangs 'khor longs spyod rgyas par= rin po che yid bzhin nor bu la sogs pa 'bru nor bang mdzod 'phel bar mdzod cig yid la bsam pa'i don thams cad 'grub par mdzod cig sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bri/ de'i phyi rol du mgon po'i sku drung ltar bri ba la/ sku dar nag gi ber/ phyag g.yas bing chen/ g.yon thod khrag gi nang du/ me tog pad+ma'i steng du nor bu 'bar bas mtshan pa dang*/ spyi bor pad zla'i steng du spyan ras gzigs sam yang na hrīḥ sa mtshan pa bri'o/ pha waṃ long bu la hūm̐ bris pa (360) byang sems dkar dmar/ seng ldeng phur pa/ gri snying dum bu rnams lhan gcig gzhag rab gnas dang tshogs bdag gi mnga' gsol bya/ sgrub pa tshar nas mchan khung g.yas su btags pas mgon po lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las ci 'dod pa 'grub par gsungs/ 'khor lo 'bri sgrub kyi skabs su/ dme pho mdze long*/ khyi dang bud med rnams kyi mi mthong bar bya'o/ gzhan rnams 'dra//
